title: Scripture and Teaching
definition: Scripture and teaching belong together because God's people must be instructed in sound doctrine and trained to follow Christ.
summary: Christian teaching explains the Word clearly so believers may grow in truth and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus is the Teacher and Lord, and all faithful teaching leads people toward His truth and obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Teaching is a serious ministry because it shapes what people believe about God, salvation, sin, obedience, and hope. Faithful teaching must be anchored in Scripture.

Teachers are not called to entertain or impress. They are called to explain truth clearly, guard doctrine, correct error, and help believers obey Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Bad teaching can confuse souls and weaken the Church. Scripture and teaching matters because God's people need truth presented with clarity, humility, and faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Teach only what is faithful to Scripture. If you are learning, test teaching by the Word. If you teach, prepare carefully and remember the responsibility before God.
